description: Source code for managing services via ubus, including loading services from JSON files, registering/unregistering services, listing services, and retrieving reference data through ubus calls.

methods.name: add_service_to_list
methods.description: Adds a new service entry to the registered services list.

methods.name: load_service_from_file
methods.description: Loads service configuration from a JSON file and registers it.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters directory entries, excluding hidden files.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares directory entries for sorting by length and alphabetically.

methods.name: register_services
methods.description: Scans a directory for service JSON files and loads them.

methods.name: unregister_services
methods.description: Unregisters all registered services and frees resources.

methods.name: list_registered_services
methods.description: Lists all registered services in a blob buffer.

methods.name: is_path_match
methods.description: Checks if a requested path and protocol match a service's objects.

methods.name: get_ubus_object_name
methods.description: Retrieves the ubus object name corresponding to a service path.

methods.name: reference_data_callback
methods.description: Callback to handle ubus response and extract reference data.

methods.name: get_reference_data
methods.description: Retrieves reference data from ubus for a given path and method.
